block-guide:
CORE/TABS (new in WordPress 7) Content split into tabs: a row of tab buttons, one panel of blocks per tab. WordPress adds the switching and keyboard behaviour itself when the page renders; write no script. REQUIRED STRUCTURE (exact) core/tabs > core/tab-list (the buttons), then core/tab-panels > core/tab-panel (one per tab). Exactly one tab-list and one tab-panels, in this order; the editor locks this pair. Button N in the tab-list belongs to panel N: same count, same order. MARKUP (checked in the editor)
